fields.name: rivals
fields.tooltip: The pilots on the grid, front row first. One pooled shell each, built at bind.

fields.name: gridColumns
fields.tooltip: Racers per grid row (the ship included).

fields.name: gridRowSpacing
fields.tooltip: Metres between two grid rows along the track.

fields.name: gridLaneSpacing
fields.tooltip: Metres between two grid lanes across the track.

fields.name: playerGridSlot
fields.tooltip: The ship's own slot, counted row by row from the front-left (0). -1 = the middle of the back row, so the player starts behind the field.

fields.name: rubberBand
fields.tooltip: Most the rubber band moves a rival's thrust and target pace, as a ± share: a rival ahead of the ship eases off, one behind pushes. Keeps a runaway leader catchable without erasing the skill spread.

fields.name: rubberRange
fields.tooltip: Gap to the ship at which the rubber band is at full strength, metres.

fields.name: ghostPaceFactor
fields.tooltip: A ghost (out of sight) accelerates and cruises at its thrust and target pace × this — the stand-in for the time it would lose to sweeps and hazards.

fields.name: thrustShare
fields.tooltip: Acceleration up to its target pace, as a share of the player's ship's BASE thrust (its definition asset, before Store upgrades). Below 1 a player holding the throttle out-accelerates the field and the orbs decide the race; upgrades make the player faster against it.

fields.name: overPaceBleed
fields.tooltip: Above its target pace (a boost), the speed bleeds back down at this rate, m/s².

fields.name: orbBoostShare
fields.tooltip: Share of a boost orb's speed a rival gets when it takes one (used up, like the patrol's).

fields.name: formVariance
fields.tooltip: Each run every rival's thrust and pace are rolled up to this ± share off its authored values: its form on the day, so the same field finishes in a different order.

fields.name: surgeAmount
fields.tooltip: How much a rival's thrust swings over the run (± share), each on its own slow wave: surges and fades that make the pack trade places.

fields.name: surgePeriod
fields.tooltip: Seconds per swing of the surge.

fields.name: launchReaction
fields.tooltip: Each rival's reaction at lights out, seconds after the ship moves (rolled per run in this band): the grid breaks up from the first second.

fields.name: laneSpread
fields.tooltip: Share of the half road a rival's home lane is rolled across each run (0 = its grid lane for the whole race).

fields.name: leadGovernor
fields.tooltip: A rival AHEAD of the ship can go no faster than the ship's recent speed × a factor (Near right ahead, Far at the rubber range and beyond). Rivals drive clean and lose nothing to beams, walls or braking; without this a leader built on one bad stretch of the player's was never caught.

fields.name: leadCapNear
fields.tooltip: Speed cap, as a share of the ship's recent speed, for a rival just ahead of it: above 1 it can still pull away a little while you are close.

fields.name: leadCapFar
fields.tooltip: Speed cap, as a share of the ship's recent speed, for a rival the rubber range or more ahead: below 1 a player holding their speed always reels it in.

fields.name: leadSpeedSmoothing
fields.tooltip: Seconds the ship's speed is smoothed over for the cap: a laser hit or a fall does not stop the field dead.

fields.name: shipHalfLength
fields.tooltip: The ship's half length along the track, for contact with rivals.

fields.name: shipHalfWidth
fields.tooltip: The ship's half width across the track, for contact with rivals.

fields.name: ramClosingThreshold
fields.tooltip: Closing speed below which running into a rival is a nudge (it is held clear, nobody pays), m/s.

fields.name: ramSpeedCost
fields.tooltip: Share of the ship's speed a ram from behind costs it.

fields.name: ramSpeedTransfer
fields.tooltip: Share of the closing speed a rammed rival is knocked forward with.

fields.name: sideShoveMeters
fields.tooltip: Metres a side-by-side contact throws each hull away from the other (the ship's dash scale).

fields.name: sideShoveBias
fields.tooltip: How far the side shove is weighted toward the one that was NOT steering in: 0 = both always shoved the same, 0.6 = the loser of a hard swerve takes 1.6x the shove and the winner 0.4x.

fields.name: ramKnockMeters
fields.tooltip: Metres a rammed rival is knocked sideways (its side picked by where it was hit).

fields.name: passLookaheadSeconds
fields.tooltip: Seconds of travel ahead a rival plans to pass the ship rather than run into it.

fields.name: creditWindow
fields.tooltip: A rival wrecked within this many seconds of its last contact with the ship is the player's kill (and pays its bounty).

fields.name: contactSparkColor
fields.tooltip: Colour of the sparks a contact throws.

fields.name: lateralSpeed
fields.tooltip: Lateral speed full steer settles at, m/s.

fields.name: handlingResponse
fields.tooltip: Lateral drag, 1/s: how fast the lateral velocity settles.

fields.name: gripBase
fields.tooltip: Grip on a flat sweep at rest, m/s².

fields.name: gripPerSpeed
fields.tooltip: Extra grip per m/s of speed.

fields.name: brakeDecel
fields.tooltip: Deceleration at full brake, m/s².

fields.name: slideThreshold
fields.tooltip: Outward lateral speed past which a slip is a slide, m/s.

fields.name: slideSpeedLoss
fields.tooltip: Share of the forward speed a slide scrubs per second.

fields.name: orbLookaheadSeconds
fields.tooltip: Seconds of travel ahead a boost orb is considered.

fields.name: hazardLookaheadSeconds
fields.tooltip: Seconds of travel ahead a ramp or laser gate is planned for.

fields.name: gateClearance
fields.tooltip: Metres past a horizontal beam's end (or a rotor blade's tip) a rival treats as burning — the emitter's body plus a margin.

fields.name: verticalBeamHalfWidth
fields.tooltip: Half width of a VERTICAL beam's sheet, metres either side of it, for gates not built yet. Once one is built its measured width is used when larger (the shipped model is ~10 m).

fields.name: gateMargin
fields.tooltip: Extra metres a rival keeps between its hull and a beam's zone, on top of the clearances above: steering closes on its line gradually, so the target sits this far inside the free road.

fields.name: curveLookaheadSeconds
fields.tooltip: Seconds of travel ahead a flat sweep is braked for.

fields.name: rivalSeparation
fields.tooltip: Least lateral gap two rivals side by side keep, metres.

fields.name: mistakeOverspeed
fields.tooltip: A rival that misjudges a flat sweep arrives at its grip limit × this (above 1 it slides, and may go off an open edge).

fields.name: mistakeEdgeShave
fields.tooltip: A rival that misjudges an open edge holds its line this far past it — long enough and it falls.

fields.name: edgeHazardLength
fields.tooltip: Metres of open-edged road counted as one hazard (one roll of the rival's mistake rate).

fields.name: killCam
fields.tooltip: A rival wrecked near the ship (in view) plays the kill cam: slow motion, a cut to a planted shot of the explosion, the ship on autopilot and untouchable, then back.

fields.name: killCamRange
fields.tooltip: Farthest a wreck can be from the ship, along the track, and still play it.

fields.name: killCamTimeScale
fields.tooltip: The world clock's scale at the bottom of the slow motion.

fields.name: killCamSeconds
fields.tooltip: Real seconds the shot holds at full slow motion.

fields.name: killCamBlend
fields.tooltip: Real seconds the clock eases in and back out.

fields.name: killCamGrace
fields.tooltip: Seconds the ship stays untouchable (blinking) after the cut back.

fields.name: killCamCooldown
fields.tooltip: Real seconds after one kill cam before another can play.

fields.name: killCamOffset
fields.tooltip: The camera's spot, from the explosion in the track's frame: metres out to its side (away from the ship), up, and ahead along the track.

fields.name: fullSimBand
fields.tooltip: The full-sim window round the ship: metres BEHIND it / AHEAD of it (clamped to the built road). Outside it a rival is a ghost. Keep the ahead edge past the fog.

fields.name: finishFlightSeconds
fields.tooltip: Seconds a finished rival flies on off its ramp before it is parked.

fields.name: debugReadout
fields.tooltip: Prints the live standings and each rival's state, pace and fidelity on screen.

fields.name: debugGhostWireframes
fields.tooltip: Draws every ghost rival (hidden, off the full sim) as a wireframe box in its map colour, where its distance and home lane put it.

fields.name: displayName
fields.tooltip: Debug / inspector name of this pilot.

fields.name: prefab
fields.tooltip: The rival's model. Instantiated under the pooled shell with its transform reset and every collider stripped. Empty = a code-built placeholder hull in the map colour.

fields.name: scale
fields.tooltip: Size of the model.

fields.name: yawOffset
fields.tooltip: Yaw that turns the model's nose down its own +Z.

fields.name: hoverHeight
fields.tooltip: Height of the model above the flight line, along the track's up.

fields.name: halfLength
fields.tooltip: Half its length along the track, for contact and spacing.

fields.name: halfWidth
fields.tooltip: Half its width across the track, for contact, spacing and pickups.

fields.name: paintTint
fields.tooltip: Paint over the model's own colour; the alpha is how much of it (0 = the model as authored, 1 = fully this colour). Applied to a per-rival copy of the model's materials.

fields.name: mapColor
fields.tooltip: Its dot on the minimap (and the placeholder hull's colour).

fields.name: cruiseFraction
fields.tooltip: Cruise pace as a share of the run's Light Speed. The pack's skill spread lives here.

fields.name: thrustFactor
fields.tooltip: How hard it accelerates, as a multiple of the field's thrust. With the pace caps out of reach on most tracks, this is what orders the pack.

fields.name: aggression
fields.tooltip: How far it wanders off its grid lane fighting for the line, 0 (holds its lane) to 1 (all over the road).

fields.name: mistakeRate
fields.tooltip: Chance per hazard of misjudging it (late brake for a flat sweep, a shaved open edge, a gap at the end). Read from M3 of the race PRD.

fields.name: orbAppetite
fields.tooltip: Chance it goes for a boost orb it can reach. Rolled once per orb.

fields.name: ramHull
fields.tooltip: Rams from behind it takes before it is wrecked.

fields.name: bounty
fields.tooltip: Money the player is paid when it is wrecked because of them (a ram, or a shove into a beam, off an edge or into a gap). Its own mistakes pay nothing.
